disambiguation: Not a general trip planner; it is specifically designed for planning and executing sourcing trips.
extras: Early release (v0.14.1). Requires Node.js 22+ for building. MIT licensed.
problem: Managing complex, multi-stop sourcing trips, tracking location details, and documenting visits across different devices is cumbersome.

relations.evidence: Google Maps export previews retain every selected destination, including shared parking and endpoints.
The map implementation is adapted from Obsidian Maps 0.2.2, MIT © 2025 Obsidian

summary: A local sourcing notebook for planning trips, tracking visited locations, and recording purchase details using maps and structured notes.
